hints.title: Running Frequency Table
hints.text: Maintain frequency counts of all 26 lowercase English letters as the right endpoint expands.

hints.title: Calculate Max and Min Frequencies
hints.text: Beauty is max frequency minus min non-zero frequency; accumulate across all pairs i and j.

hints.title: Full Implementation
hints.text:
```python
class Solution:
    def beautySum(self, s: str) -> int:
        n = len(s)
        total_beauty = 0
        for i in range(n):
            freq = [0] * 26
            for j in range(i, n):
                freq[ord(s[j]) - ord('a')] += 1
                mx = max(freq)
                mn = min(f for f in freq if f > 0)
                total_beauty += mx - mn
        return total_beauty
```

variables: n is length of string s (<= 500)
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Extracting and scanning substrings individually takes O(n^3) time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Incremental frequency table evaluates beauty in O(26) per right endpoint, taking O(26 * n^2) total time.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate maintains running character frequencies and excludes zero counts from minimum.
